title: The Baum-Connes and the Mishchenko-Kasparov assembly maps for group extensions
summary: In this paper, we investigate the injectivity, surjectivity and isomorphism of the Baum--Connes assembly map $e_{\ast}$ with coefficients, and the injectivity of the Mishchenko--Kasparov assembly map $μ_{\ast}$ with coefficients for group extensions $1\rightarrow N \rightarrow Γ\xrightarrow{q} Γ/ N \rightarrow 1$. The main results are as follows. (1) Under the assumption that $e_{\ast}$ is isomorphic for $q^{-1}(F)$ for any finite subgroup $F$ of $Γ/N$, we prove that $e_{\ast}$ is injective, surjective and isomorphic for $Γ$ if they are also true for $Γ/N$, respectively.
